depolarizing_noise_action: H_delta=(1-delta)H+delta I/12 preserves the complete optimizer set
optimal_set: H>=0, Tr(H)=1, H_ii=1/12 for all i, and H_ij>=0 for i!=j
theorem: Optimality first forces every diagonal entry to equal 1/12 because the adversary contains E_ii. Write K=H-I/12. If some K_ij<0, a normalized rank-one adversary proportional to (e_i+epsilon e_j)(e_i+epsilon e_j)^T lowers the response below 1/12 for small epsilon. Conversely nonnegative off-diagonal K pairs nonnegatively with every entrywise-nonnegative adversary. These conditions are therefore necessary and sufficient.
